about: What str() and float() make of YAML's types: a number as a string, a source written as a number, an empty source (the text None), decided: yes (the text True), a blank unit, an empty reason and a zero margin.

files.model.yaml:
model: tiny
title: types in the yaml
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  stored:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB
    value: 15
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "what is held, as stated for this case"}

  index:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: GB
    value: 500
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the index, as stated for this case"}

  disk_per_host:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB/host
    value: 2
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the disk each host has, as stated for this case"}

  from_a_string:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: TB
    value: "12.5"
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: 12}

  nameless_source:
    kind: input
    decided: yes
    unit: ""
    value: 3
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source:}

  empty_reason:
    kind: ceiling
    unit: dimensionless
    of: busy_cores / cores
    limit: 1
    headroom: 0
    because:

  combined:
    kind: derived
    unit: TB
    formula: from_a_string * nameless_source

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - combined
  - empty_reason
  - index
  - disk_per_host
  - stored

overrides: {}

problems.message: _builder_conformance/types-in-the-yaml/model.yaml: input 'nameless_source' declares decided 'True'; expected one of you, outside, definition. `you` is a choice somebody could make differently, `outside` is an observation whether or not it has a shape yet, and `definition` is an identity like a year in seconds.
